stories.headline: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Following Espionage Scandal
stories.summary: Nvidia's board has unanimously reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as chief executive, less than two weeks after his resignation. Huang had stepped down amid an alleged espionage scandal involving a woman suspected of spying for China. His return followed assurances from senior US government officials, including direct contacts and the involvement of US President Donald Trump and an emissary, which led to criticism from US lawmakers.
